title: fix: preserve stream-read errors and terminal diagnostics
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preserve the original upstream stream-read message in error metrics instead of collapsing it into missing usage.
- Keep the stream ending within the existing 16,000-character error-log budget, even with oversized chunks. Full billing input remains untouched.
- Keep diagnostic helpers outside the main stream and tracking flow. No generation retries, timeout changes, or weaker billing validation.
- Pin the merged gateway fix: https://github.com/pollinations/gateway/pull/13. Builds on #14730.
- Verified: 95 Gen tests, Gen type-check, pinned-version formatting, and a real gateway → Gen → usage-validator connection-reset reproduction pass.

gist.headline: The stream keeps receipts
gist.blurb: When an upstream stream hiccups, the hive now keeps the actual note instead of filing everything under “missing usage.” Error logs stay neatly within their 16,000-character planter box while billing keeps its full input.
gist.summary: Gen now preserves original upstream stream-read error messages in metrics, caps terminal diagnostics at the existing 16,000-character error-log budget even for oversized chunks, and pins the corresponding gateway fix from gateway PR #13.
gist.impact: Developers get the real stream-read failure context in Gen diagnostics while usage validation and full billing input remain intact, making connection-reset and similar failures far easier to trace.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy stream-monitoring garden: Polli, wearing tiny mechanic goggles, tends a retro terminal beside a carefully bounded diagnostic log jar labeled “16K.” A friendly CRT Monitor Robot watches a winding data stream carrying a readable error note into the jar, while the untouched full billing ledger sits safely in a flower pot; code-plants and vines make the careful observability work feel warm rather than alarming.
